primitives.name: Authoritative Logo Lock
primitives.verbatim_quote: After confirming authority, immediately persist each official Essential Kit slot with `lock_authoritative_logo`, `lock_authoritative_palette`, or `lock_authoritative_typography`.
primitives.assumptions: User confirms ownership and explicit authorization to reuse prior Higgsfield uploads or user-supplied assets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No breakdown; fails if authorization is denied or asset integrity is compromised.

layer2.mapping: Maps the persistent locking of official digital assets to the GSI/GSE requirement of verifiable provenance and immutable asset registration, ensuring that all inputs to generative models are legally cleared and technically verified.
layer2.telemetry: Successful completion of the asset persistence command (`lock_authoritative_logo`) serves as empirical confirmation of both authorization and technical readiness.

primitives.name: Asset Role Inventory
primitives.verbatim_quote: Inventory and assign roles Inspect every attachment and local path supplied in the conversation.
primitives.assumptions: All attachments and local paths are accessible and correctly identified by the user.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if any asset is inaccessible, corrupted, or mislabeled.

layer2.mapping: Maps the systematic inspection and categorization of digital assets to the GSI/GSE process of cataloging input data, where each piece of media is assigned a specific role (e.g., logo, palette, template) to ensure proper handling and application in downstream systems.
layer2.telemetry: Completion of the inventory task provides a structured dataset of asset roles, serving as a verification metric for the completeness of the input set.

primitives.name: Exact Local Path Preservation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Preserve the exact local path, URL, upload ID, or job ID plus the source summary and `user_supplied` origin.
primitives.assumptions: The local path, URL, or identifier is stable and correctly reflects the asset's location and origin.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the preserved path becomes invalid or points to a different asset.

layer2.mapping: Maps the preservation of the exact locator (URL, ID) to the GSI/GSE need for reproducible data fetching, ensuring that the exact version of an asset can always be retrieved and verified, maintaining consistency across all generated outputs.
layer2.telemetry: Successful preservation of the locator string acts as a direct metric for data provenance and retrieval reliability.

primitives.name: Dominant Color Measurement
primitives.verbatim_quote: Do not reproduce the reference's logo, distinctive layout, illustration, pattern, or artwork, and do not pass it into logo generation.
primitives.assumptions: The downloaded asset is an accurate representation of the original and the measurement tooling is correctly applied.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the measurement yields incorrect color values due to tooling error or image corruption.

layer2.mapping: Maps the extraction of chromatic data (dominant colors) from visual assets to the GSI/GSE requirement of extracting perceptual features from images, enabling consistent color-based styling and visual coherence in generated materials.
layer2.telemetry: The set of extracted dominant colors serves as a direct observable for verifying the accuracy of the color analysis.
